classification.difficultyReason: Interpret equality and right-angle markings, select Pythagoras to recover missing sides, distinguish a missing leg from a hypotenuse, then sum and simplify the perimeter.

content.prompt: Calculate the perimeter in simplest form.

spec.description: Unshaded rectangle, wider than tall, with bottom and right side labels. Ordinary source blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: Rectangle with adjacent side lengths sqrt(2) cm and sqrt(5) cm; opposite sides equal.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied side lengths are visible.

spec.description: Unshaded long horizontal rectangle with bottom and right side labels. Ordinary source blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: Rectangle with adjacent side lengths 3sqrt(8) cm and sqrt(2) cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied side lengths are visible.

spec.description: Right triangle with horizontal top and vertical left legs, descending to the bottom-left vertex. Right-angle square at top left; unlabelled hypotenuse.
spec.mathematics: Perpendicular legs sqrt(8) cm and sqrt(2) cm; hypotenuse sqrt(10) cm.

answer.short: $(3\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{10})\text{ cm}$; missing side $=\sqrt{10}\text{ cm}$ by Pythagoras.
answer.worked:
Let $h$ be the hypotenuse in centimetres.
$$\begin{align*}h^2&=(\sqrt{8})^2+(\sqrt{2})^2\\&=10\\h&=\sqrt{10}\\P&=\sqrt{8}+\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{10}\\&=3\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{10}\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with equal top and right legs marked by matching double ticks; right-angle square at top right.
spec.mathematics: Both perpendicular sides have length sqrt(20) cm. Hypotenuse sqrt(40) cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the right leg length and supplied equality marks are visible.

answer.short: $(4\sqrt{5}+2\sqrt{10})\text{ cm}$; equal legs and Pythagoras give the missing sides.
answer.worked:
The matching ticks show that both legs are $\sqrt{20}\text{ cm}$. Let $h$ be the hypotenuse in centimetres.
$$\begin{align*}h^2&=(\sqrt{20})^2+(\sqrt{20})^2\\&=40\\h&=2\sqrt{10}\\P&=2\sqrt{20}+2\sqrt{10}\\&=4\sqrt{5}+2\sqrt{10}\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with vertical left leg and horizontal bottom leg; right-angle square at bottom left and unlabelled diagonal.
spec.mathematics: Perpendicular legs sqrt(3) m and sqrt(27) m; hypotenuse sqrt(30) m.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied leg lengths are visible.

answer.short: $(4\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{30})\text{ m}$; missing side $=\sqrt{30}\text{ m}$ by Pythagoras.
answer.worked:
Let $h$ be the hypotenuse in metres.
$$\begin{align*}h^2&=(\sqrt{3})^2+(\sqrt{27})^2\\&=30\\h&=\sqrt{30}\\P&=\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{27}+\sqrt{30}\\&=4\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{30}\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with horizontal top leg, vertical right leg and labelled diagonal; right-angle square at top right.
spec.mathematics: Top leg sqrt(27) cm; hypotenuse sqrt(75) cm; missing right leg sqrt(48) cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Missing leg and perimeter remain hidden.

answer.short: $12\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}$; missing side $=4\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}$ by Pythagoras.
answer.worked:
Let $x$ be the missing leg in centimetres.
$$\begin{align*}x^2&=(\sqrt{75})^2-(\sqrt{27})^2\\&=48\\x&=4\sqrt{3}\\P&=\sqrt{27}+4\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{75}\\&=3\sqrt{3}+4\sqrt{3}+5\sqrt{3}\\&=12\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
